items.summary: Legal disposition: BLOCKED for public launch and monetization of SearchWoot; keep it private and preview-only. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not redistribution, storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, affiliate, advertising, image, price, attribution, freshness, correction, or takedown rights; public terms restrict commercial/public listing use. Human counsel review and owner-authorized outreach are required. Fleet compliance is not clear: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown; security, accuracy, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Permit ordinary reversible growth only where it adds no new data collection, credentials, permissions, dependencies, or cross-site behavior. Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net private, preview-only, and unlaunched pending concrete readiness packets.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active with 0 of 4 legal tasks evidenced as closed. Existing progress: source-rights baseline is documented; data-flow and consent evidence are partial; public terms are draft-only. Do not close any task. Next evidence actions: assemble the field-level Woot rights matrix for counsel review; produce the alert-data retention/deletion/access table; capture deployed consent and GA4 settings; and inventory logs, vendors, retention, incident, and data-request procedures.
